act.name: Electricity Act, 2003
act.source_authority: Ministry of Power, Government of India
act.description: Central law regulating electricity supply, consumer standards, disconnection, unauthorised use and theft.

sections.title: Disconnection of supply in default of payment.
sections.text: Section 56 governs disconnection of electricity supply for payment default and the required notice.
sections.plain_language_summary: A licensee may disconnect for unpaid electricity charges only through the statutory written-notice process, subject to the section's conditions.
